review_method: Assistant manual inspection of preserved source markup, node roles and ordered body offsets; no browser-rendered visual inspection
checks: All selected challenge roles inspected in saved source
Inline gap and generic division retention
Explicit heading levels without section meaning
Empty/native-whitespace nodes excluded from content denominator
limitations: Paragraph labels may be heading-like and heading tags may be related links
Only literal source-paragraph projection is supported; low coverage does not exclude corpus admission
